topic: Adding session metrics to lidar data table
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on enhancing the existing 3D lidar data table with specific session metrics. The following fields were agreed upon for inclusion:

*   `area_session_start`: To capture the starting area of a session.
*   `area_session_duration`: To capture the duration of a session.
*   Vector representation: For movement vectors, it was decided to include `entry_delta_x`, `entry_delta_y`, `exit_delta_x`, and `exit_delta_y` (all Float64). This vector represents the difference between two past points divided by the time difference.

The data structure proposed by [me] for these fields was accepted.
decisions: Add `area_session_start` and `area_session_duration` to the 3D lidar data table.
Include four Float64 fields (`entry_delta_x`, `entry_delta_y`, `exit_delta_x`, `exit_delta_y`) representing movement vectors in the table.
action_items: [me] to update the 3D lidar data table with the specified session metrics and vector fields.
